Commentary.Commentary: That concludes this game. Aussies go second on the table for now. On 1st November, two games are lined up but first, it will be Afghanistan taking on Sri Lanka at 9.30 am IST (4 am GMT). Do join us for the coverage. Cheers!

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland says it was a tough game, Finch's innings took it away, they bowled well for the most parts but a few overs did not go their way. Credits Tucker for the way he played and he hopes he can continue to do well.

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia is also the Player of the Match. He says it was not the easiest of wicket as it played slow and 180 was a good score on the wicket. Adds he is feeling no pressure, there has been a lot of support for him, he has trained really well and that is all you can control. Mentions there will be good days and there will be bad days. States wide balls were not easy to face but when they were bowling straight, it was easier. Informs he will get a scan and he hopes the injury is not bad enough. Ends by saying they are very hopeful of going through. Finch says it was a good performance, he felt 180 was a good score. Adds they needed to lay the foundation early but they found it difficult to get going straight on. Informs David had a niggle but nothing to worry. States England and New Zealand is a big game, it would have been great to dismiss Ireland for a lot lower but Tucker played a brilliant knock.
...Presentation coming up...

Earlier in the day, Australia, after being inserted, struggled for the first 10 overs with the bat. However, they managed to score around 100 in the last 10 courtesy of Finch and Stoinis and that took their total to which we felt was above par. Ireland, despite the efforts of Lorcan Tucker, have fallen well short of the Aussie total.

Australia will be slightly disappointed they only managed to win by 42 runs. They just leaked a lot of runs once the Powerplay ended, especially Starc, Cummins and Hazlewood. They were poor once the ball got old. They were either too full or too short. However, pretty sure Australia's number one priority heading into this game was the two points and they have got that.

Had it not been for Lorcan Tucker, this could have well been embarrassing for Ireland. The Aussie players ran through the top order in no time and they were 5 down in the Powerplay itself. Maxwell and Starc did the damage earlier on. After that though, it was the Tucker show. He really took on the Aussie bowlers. There were wickets falling at the other end but he batted brilliantly. Found the boundaries at ease. Was dropped and he made full use of the life he got. Ireland have to thank for coming so close or at one stage, it seemed the margin of defeat could be well over 100.

How costly is that drop from Cummins going to be? Yes, despite that it is still a good win for them but they would have wanted the margin to be a lot higher. Maybe had Cummins taken the catch, Australia might have bettered England's NRR at the end of this game but that is not the case now. Still though, the Aussies have kept their campaign alive with two wins in a row.

OUT! RUN OUT! Tossed up on middle. Little reverse sweeps it to point and tries to give the strike to Tucker but is slow as he runs across. The throw from Marsh comes to the bowler's side and Maxwell clips the bails off. The replay shows Little is well short. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 42 RUNS.
A wicket and a single of this over! Length and on middle. Little works it to deep mid-wicket for one. Ireland need 43 runs in 12 balls.
Bangs a bouncer and this one climbs off the deck. Little fails to get his bat on it.
A bouncer from Cummins on the body. Little looks to pull but misses. Good delivery this.
Short of a length and around off. Little bends as he looks to dab it away but misses.

OUT! TAKEN! McCarthy goes! Short ball on off. McCarthy pulls it flat and hard but straight in the hands of Steven Smith (sub) who gets low and takes the catch. Australia will look to take the last wicket quickly now.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Steven Smith b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: A bumper, outside off. McCarthy slashes and misses.
A full toss on middle, Lorcan Tucker flicks it to deep mid-wicket for two. Apart from the first over, Starc has been very expensive. 44 runs needed in 18 balls.
Wide! Goes full but down the leg side. Lorcan Tucker misses his flick.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Pitched up, outside on middle. Lorcan Tucker makes room and drives non the up over mid off for a boundary.
Starc goes very full, outside off. Lorcan Tucker makes room as he looks to drive but misses.
Wide! Short ball, slower and on middle. Lorcan Tucker slashes and misses. Wide given for height.
Around leg, Lorcan Tucker flicks it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Mid off was in and gets a boundary! This is full and around off. Lorcan Tucker lofts it over mid off for another boundary.
FOUR! That is played so well! Lorcan Tucker has played some amazing shots! On a length and on middle. Lorcan Tucker shuffles across and laps it behind the keeper for four runs.
A yorker, outside off. McCarthy fails to squeeze it out.
Well bowled! A yorker on leg. Lorcan Tucker somehow gets his bat on it, the ball rolls to point for one.
FOUR! Lorcan Tucker is not giving up yet! Full and outside off. Lorcan Tucker steps across and swings, slices it over backward point for a boundary.
SIX! Lorcan Tucker reaches fifty in style! While others struggled he has played an impressive innings. Full and on middle. Lorcan Tucker smokes it over long on for a biggie.
No pace there! A short ball on middle. Lorcan Tucker looks to pull but misses.
Length ball, outside off. McCarthy pulls it to mid on who collects on a bounce. One.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Tucker steps out, does not get to the pitch of it and swings, it goes off the inner half towards deep imd-wicket for one.
On off, this is eased down to long off for one.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to cover.

OUT! TIMBER! Fionn Hand walks back! Zampa has another one! This is very full, Fionn Hand walks across, exposing his stumps and looks to sweep. Picks the wrong ball as it is way too full and it hits the stumps.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
FOUR! That is very nicely timed! Fuller and outside off, this is hit wide of deep point and into the fence behind.
Another short one around off, Hand looks to upper cut it but misses.
A low full toss, this is hit down to long on for one.
Digs it in short and on the body, this is nudged around the corner for one.
This lands safe! Shorter and on off, Tucker looks to pull, it goes off the top edge but lands safe on the leg side. One.
A slower short ball on middle, Lorcan Tucker looks to pull but misses.
Tucker keeps strike as he works this through mid-wicket for one.
Really good running! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket. Two taken.
Steps out, makes it into a full toss and hits it down to long off for one.
Flatter and on off, defended.

OUT! STUMPED! Zampa gets his first and Mark Adair falls! This is flatter, drags his length back as he sees Mark Adair step out. It is outside off too. Adair still swings, misses and Wade does the rest.
Commentary.Howout: st Matthew Wade b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.

DROPPED! Cummins just not has been at his best in the field in this tournament! Yes, this had gone really high up in the air but you expect him to take that. A slower one, on middle, Lorcan Tucker swings but is early in the swing. It goes high up in the air towards mid-wicket. Cummins settles under it but spills it. A single taken. A really good over for Ireland. Lorcan Tucker deserves a little luck, he has played really well.
Carved away for two more! Outside off, fuller, this is played over point for a couple.
Lands short! Outside off, Lorcan Tucker looks to guide it down to third man but it goes off the bottom edge and rolls to the keeper.
FOUR! Through the off side now! Lorcan Tucker gives himself a bit of room and Starc goes full and on off, this is hit past mid off and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Pulled away! Shorter and on middle, Lorcan Tucker drags it wide of mid-wicket for a boundary. He is playing reall well here.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, defended.
A single as this is played through point.
On off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Cut away! This is nicely played! Shorter and around off, it is cut past point for a boundary.
On off, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Length ball on middle, slower. Adair makes room and smacks it to long on for just a single. 107 runs needed for Ireland to win.
A short ball on middle. Mark looks to ramp it over but misses.
On middle, length and Adair whips it to deep square leg for a single.
In the air but safe! Short in length and outside off. Mark Adair looks to hoick but gets a leading edge and it lobs behind the keeper for a brace.

DRINKS! Australia are truly in a position to beat Ireland with a big margin. They are into the bowling all-rounders and they will be eager to bowl them out quickly. Ireland on the other hand are playing with intent but are constantly losing wickets. Can they somehow play out the 20 overs?

OUT! CAUGHT! The stand is broken! Australia needed this wicket! Marcus Stoinis strikes in his very first over. On a length and on top of middle. Gareth Delany looks to pull but the length was not that short, he gets a top edge and it flies to mid on. Glenn Maxwell runs across from mid-wicket, calls for it and takes the catch. Good take there and Ireland are 6 down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Maxwell b Marcus Stoinis

Commentary.Commentary: This is full and outside off, driven through covers for one.

The throw should have gone to the keeper! On middle. Lorcan Tucker flicks it to mid-wicket. The batters cross and looks for one more but the throw comes to the bowler's end. Adam Zampa then throws it to Wade but he too throws waywardly.
A slower, floated ball, outside off. George Dockrell smashes it to long on for a single.
On middle, this is hit to long on for a single.
A shout for LBW but it was just outside the line. This is flatter and outside off. Lorcan Tucker steps across to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
A slider, outside off. Gareth Delany works it to point for one.
Starts with a full toss, outside off. Lorcan Tucker pushes it to long off for one.
A slower, short ball, outside off. Gareth Delany dabs it straight to backward point.
This is full and on middle, it is hit to long on for one.
Wide! Wade appeals but it is given as a wide. Short ball, angling down. Lorcan Tucker looks to pull but misses.
Lorcan Tucker shuffles in his crease. This is slower and outside off. Lorcan Tucker swings and misses.
A well directed bouncer on middle. Gareth Delany pulls, gets a top edge and the ball falls in the vacant square leg region. A single.
Shorter and angling on the hips. Lorcan Tucker tickles it to fine leg for a single.
On a length and outside off. Gareth Delany pulls it to long on for a single.
A single as this is hit to cover.
FOUR! Finds the space! Flatter ball, outside off. Gareth Delany rocks back and cuts it past point. no chance for the fielder in the deep for four.
Flatter and around off. Lorcan Tucker flicks it to deep mid-wicket. The batters were looking for two but Marcus Stoinis was quick to the ball.
Fuller ball, angling on middle. Lorcan Tucker misses his sweep and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but was pitching outside leg.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Lorcan Tucker reverse sweeps it through point for one.

FOUR! A completely different over from Starc than his first one. Gives away 14 runs. This is very full and outside off. Gareth Delany drives it past point for four runs. At the end of the Powerplay, Ireland are 49/5. 131 runs needed in 84 balls.
Bye! A slower bouncer on middle. Lorcan Tucker misses his pull. It bounces in front of Wade and gets hard for him to collect. A bye taken.
Dot ball! Starc serves a widish yorker, outside off. Lorcan Tucker looks to drive but misses.
No ball! Nasty delivery! Might have slipped out of the hands. Starc serves a high full toss on middle. Lorcan Tucker steps across as he looks to lap it away but misses. A no ball is called.
Starc targets the stumps now, around off. Lorcan Tucker uses is feet and punches it to point.
FOUR! Two in a row! Starc drags his length back and serves it on middle. Lorcan Tucker reads the length quickly and pulls it past square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! A length ball on middle. Lorcan Tucker skips down and flicks it past mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary. Much needed! Lorcan Tucker is counter-attacking.
Three more! 10 from the over then! Lorcan uses his feet, he drags it wide of mid on. Josh Hazlewood gives it chase and keeps it down to three.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Lorcan Tucker looks to pull but misses to get hit high on the pads.
WIDE! Some excitment but wide signaled! Down the leg side, shorter. Lorcan Tucker looks to pull but misses.
Two more! On middle, Lorcan Tucker works it through square leg for two.

Now looks to be innovative but it does not come off. The ball goes just over the middle pole. Lorcan Tucker looks to play the paddle scoop, this one is on a length, it tails back in from outside off. Tucker misses and it goes over the middle pole.
FOUR! That is a really good shot! Lorcan Tucker looking to counter-attack! He steps out, makes it into a half volley and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Change. Pat Cummins is back on.

OUT! TIMBER! Ireland are falling like a pack of cards here! Another one bites the dust and yet again it is an over which sees two wickets. Too good from Starc! He goes full and gets it to shape back in from outside off. George Dockrell fails to get his bat down in time and it hits the off pole. Half the side back in the hut and we are not even done with 30 legal balls in this game.
Fuller and outside off, George Dockrell leaves it alone.
Looks to go for an inswinging yorker again but ends up serving a fast full toss, this is pushed to mid off.
Fuller and angles it away, it is outside off. George Dockrell looks to go after it away from the body but misses.

OUT! TIMBER! Starc has just turned back the clock! He is at his best when he gets that little bit of shape into the batter. Strikes second ball and Curtis Campher falls for a golden duck! This is full, it starts on off and gets it to shape back in. Curtis Campher fails to keep it out as he tries to play it with the full face of the bat. The stumps are hit. You know this is coming but just can't do anything about it. Ireland are 4 down now.

That has swung for Starc! He is deadly if he gets that shape! This time though the length is a little too straight as he starts from around middle. Lorcan Tucker looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Half an appeal but turned down. The ball rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Starc to bowl now.

OUT! TAKEN! Two in the over for Maxwell and Ireland are now three down! Harry Tector can't believe he has picked the fielder out there. This is short and on the pads, asking to be hit. Harry Tector hits it straight to the sub Steven Smith at square leg and he makes no mistake. Ireland in deep trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Steven Smith b Glenn Maxwell

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Thumped down the ground! That is a lovely shot. Did not look to overhit it but plays it well. Fuller and on off, this is hit down the ground and to the long off fence.
Two! Steps out and Glenn Maxwell shortens the length. This is worked through square leg for two.
This lands on middle and then turns back in. Harry Tector looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

OUT! TAKEN! That move has turned out to be a master-stroke from Aaron Finch! We here were wondering an offie against two right-handers but Maxwell has provided the wicket and it is the big one. Both the openers fall now. This is short and on middle, Paul Stirling makes room. This was there to be hit but Paul slaps it straight towards mid off where it is taken by Cummins. You can't keep Pat Cummins out of the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Pat Cummins b Glenn Maxwell

Commentary.Commentary: Slows it up and lands it on middle, Paul Stirling pushes it to mid off.
Glenn Maxwell to bowl now.

OUT! TIMBER! Cummins strikes! He is delighted and he finishes the over just the way Australia would gave wanted. They need wickets and they have got one early here. This is a lovely inswinger. Starts from well outside off and it is fuller. Ends up on the off pole. Andy Balbirnie shuffles across and looks to flick it fine on the leg side but misses and the off pole is hit. The flying start is cut short then.
Nicely timed but to the fielder! On off, Andy Balbirnie guides it to point.
Now Cummins gets the ball to shape back in but the line is a little too straight. Paul Stirling looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls towards point for one.
SIX! BANG! That sails over the fence. Stirling on the charge here! Shorter and on middle, Paul Stirling picks the length early and pulls it well over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Whipped away! Way too straight and that is put away! On middle, Paul Stirling shuffles across and works it over square leg for a boundary.
An appeal but only from the bowler! A slower one outside off, this lands and cuts back in. Paul Stirling looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Who will bowl now? It is Pat Cummins.
Back of a length and on off, Andy Balbirnie pushes it to covers. 7 from the first over then.
SIX! He has picked the bones out of that one! That is a strong hit! Andy Balbirnie makes room and Josh Hazlewood follows him with a short one. It is pulled over the fine leg fence for a biggie.

What was that sound? We thought there was an edge there but no appeal. Maybe it hit the stumps. IT DID! That has samshed into the off pole. Not sure how the bails did not fall there. This starts on middle and then shapes away. Andy Balbirnie makes room and looks to go over covers but misses. It hits the off pole and goes to the keeper.
Another one on a length and around off, Andy Balbirnie pushes it to covers.
Back of a length and on off, Andy Balbirnie defends.

Straightaway goes after Josh Hazlewood! Steps out and stays leg side of the bowler. Josh Hazlewood bowls it on a length and on middle, Paul Stirling looks to go over covers but gets an inside edge towards the leg side. A run taken. Ireland and Paul are underway.
